strings.name: Li Xiang
strings.role: Li Auto founder, chairman and CEO
strings.summary: Chinese entrepreneur Li Xiang moved from IT information and automotive internet services into new-energy vehicles, founding the Autohome website and Li Auto. He leads strategy and product direction while teams develop extended-range and battery-electric vehicles; corporate achievements are not his sole inventions.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Group founding differs from holding-company incorporation, production from deliveries, and assisted from driverless driving. Q3 results scheduled for November 25 are not yet published.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Autohome and Li Auto, advancing online automotive services and smart electric vehicle products and business models.
strings.facts.f1.label: Early career
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Shijiazhuang in 1981; began website entrepreneurship in high school, later developing PCPop and Autohome. Birth year follows a contributed article; no unverified qualification is added.
strings.facts.f2.label: Former directorships
strings.facts.f2.value: NIO director, May 2015–September 2018; NavInfo independent director, May 2017–December 2021.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From content to vehicles
strings.highlights.h1.text: Extended consumer information services into vehicle products and services; his interview describes a focus on families.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Products and organizational cooperation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Oversees strategy as chairman and CEO; research, manufacturing and delivery depend on teams, with extended-range and battery-electric lines in parallel.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company schedules financial results
strings.timeline.t1.text: Li Auto announces unaudited Q3 results for November 25; only the plan is recorded at the cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Company launches 2026 Li i6
strings.timeline.t2.text: Later delivery release confirms launch and battery/chip specifications; team product progress, not his individual invention.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Hong Kong dual primary listing
strings.timeline.t3.text: Li Auto lists on HKEX’s Main Board; this differs from a secondary listing alone.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Nasdaq listing
strings.timeline.t4.text: American depositary shares trade as LI; a corporate financing and governance milestone.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First Li ONE deliveries
strings.timeline.t5.text: Deliveries follow November’s start of volume production; the dates are distinct.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Leaves Autohome presidency
strings.timeline.t6.text: Ends presidency to focus on vehicle entrepreneurship; not necessarily the end of all shares or board relationships.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds Li Auto group business
strings.timeline.t7.text: Disclosure dates group operations to April; 2017 Cayman holding-company incorporation and later renaming are separate legal events.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Creates Autohome website
strings.timeline.t8.text: Extends internet content and product experience into automotive consumer information, with team collaboration.
